facts.fact: A UN Group of Experts on Geographical Names paper of 22 January 2025 says Zambia's draft street naming and addressing policy, including postcode and digital addressing and a national address database, awaits final approval.
facts.system: Draft street naming and addressing policy

facts.fact: The same paper says the National Addressing and Postcode Project, launched in 2012 and implemented by ZICTA, is developing a public web-based address database and installing street signs and house numbers with local authorities.
